describes: packages/plugin/form without actions or annotation: hydration, geometry, the fill projection, value writes, reset, interchange, the twins and the reactive effect.

cases.name: hydrates-on-open
cases.covers: The capability reads the snapshot once when the document opens; reads return null and empty until it lands, then index by key and by widget. The twins follow the wildcard grant.

cases.name: no-read-grant-never-lists
cases.covers: Without doc.forms.read the capability fires no list at open or on refresh(), the model stays empty, and the twins say which grants the session has.

cases.name: refresh-coalesces-and-forces
cases.covers: A refresh while a read is in flight queues exactly one more read after it and resolves when that settles; any number of calls during the read coalesce into that one. (v2 forced a read per `refresh(true)`; v3 has no force argument.)

cases.name: a-failed-load-warns
cases.covers: A snapshot read that rejects is reported to console.warn and leaves the model empty; the next refresh reads again.

cases.name: widget-geometry-loads-once-per-page
cases.covers: ensureGeom reads one page of annotations, keeps object-number widgets as crop-relative content boxes (skipping other subtypes and index refs), ignores a page it is loading or has loaded or does not know, and the projection joins it.

cases.name: a-failed-geometry-read-can-retry
cases.covers: A page read that rejects clears the loading latch, so the next ensureGeom reads again.

cases.name: fill-authority-fuses-into-disabled
cases.covers: Without doc.forms.fill every projected item is disabled, read-only ones included; the grant is re-read on every projection, and a fillable session leaves the flag gate in charge.

cases.name: typed-writes
cases.covers: setText, toggle and choose send the family value through setValue, mark the field writing, and re-read the snapshot (which clears it). A null toggle clears the group.

cases.name: writes-serialize
cases.covers: A second write waits for the first one to finish, its re-read included.

cases.name: a-failed-write-reverts
cases.covers: An engine refusal clears the writing mark and rejects with the engine error; the queue carries on.

cases.name: the-write-gate
cases.covers: Without doc.forms.fill, setText/toggle/choose and reset reject with PermissionDenied before any engine call or writing mark.

cases.name: commit-value-without-scripting
cases.covers: commitValue is setValue plus a forced re-read: applied when widgets changed, unchanged otherwise, rejected with the engine error.

cases.name: reset-rides-the-batch
cases.covers: reset(key) applies one reset effect, re-reads, and patches the field from the fresh snapshot; a key the snapshot no longer has just clears the writing mark.

cases.name: a-failed-reset-batch-rejects
cases.covers: A failed or rejected reset entry rejects reset() with the entry's error message, or 'reset failed' without one, after the re-read; a thrown batch rejects with the engine error.

cases.name: reset-without-the-batch
cases.covers: An engine with no applyEffects resets through forms.reset and patches the field it answers with; a refusal reverts and rejects.

cases.name: set-value-passthrough
cases.covers: setValue is the raw engine door: it resolves with the engine result after a forced re-read, and rejects with the engine error.

cases.name: interchange
cases.covers: exportData defaults to 'xfdf'; importData passes its format through (undefined included) and SETs the snapshot the engine answers, without a re-read; repair re-reads; each rejects with the engine error.

cases.name: the-twins
cases.covers: canRead, canFill and canDesign each mirror one grant, independently.

cases.name: the-effect-folds-foreign-events
cases.covers: A remote form event re-reads the snapshot; an own value event is ignored; an own structural event clears the widget geometry and re-reads; stream.desynced re-reads; events without an origin and non-form events are ignored.

cases.name: the-effect-refresh-is-latched
cases.covers: While the effect is re-reading, further events coalesce into one more read queued after it (v2 dropped them); a failed re-read does not stop the queue.

cases.name: a-reset-action-without-a-batch-door
cases.covers: resetFormAction on an engine with no applyEffects resolves unchanged with an unsupported-api diagnostic and never reaches the engine; with no actions plugin there is no port to surface it through.

diagnostics.message: this engine has no form-effects batch door

cases.name: close-unsubscribes
cases.covers: Closing the document releases the event subscription.

cases.name: geometry-on-an-offset-crop
cases.covers: Content boxes subtract the crop origin: a page whose crop does not start at zero.
